{"notes":"Additional detail found by the discovery lens during the .102/.103 pass (2026-09-14), not yet fixed:

persona/src/main.rs:356 builds format!("{audience}?challenge={challenge}") with no escaping and no check for a query string already present in the audience. The daemon does carry the challenge through -- persona-core/src/audience.rs keeps non-persona_ query params in the audience that reaches sign_jwt_svid -- so the doc comment holds for the simple case only. Two ways it silently does not:

1. An audience that already has a query, e.g. --audience 'https://app.example/cb?tenant=acme', yields '...?tenant=acme?challenge=N'. audience.rs splits on the FIRST '?', so the whole tail is kept as one opaque param and a verifier parsing that URL gets tenant="acme?challenge=N" with no extractable challenge.
2. A peer-supplied challenge containing '&persona_...' injects daemon policy params, which the daemon then STRIPS, so the aud in the signed token is not the string the CLI constructed.

In both cases prove prints a valid-looking token and exits 0. The binding is only as good as a verifier doing an exact full-string aud comparison, and no verifier exists in this workspace."}
